title: Vintage 1950s Vogue Ginny Doll – Sleep Eyes, Poodle Skirt Outfit - Collectible
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
descriptionText:
As-Is.
No box.

Vintage Ginny doll by Vogue Dolls Inc.

Dressed in a 1950s-style outfit, including a pink poodle skirt, navy blue knitted cardigan, white socks, and black shoes—reflecting the fashion trends of that era. The tag on the skirt with Marlene Peterson’s name suggests it might have been part of a custom or reproduction outfit, as Marlene Peterson is known for doll clothing and restoration.

This particular Ginny doll appears to be a vintage hard plastic model with sleep eyes and painted facial features. The presence of the patent number and "Made in USA" further supports its authenticity as an original Vogue Ginny.
